history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration proceed to coordinate with associate departments and entities on establishing a separate pool available for associated funds for long-term employee benefits and on improving asset and liability management to match assets to current and future liabilities.
history.administration_response: Actions that have been undertaken to address this issue include but are not limited to: (a) the taking of steps to establish a separate, longer-duration and more diversified pool for extrabudgetary-related after-service health insurance reserves (which would then be available for use by other pool participants for funds with a similar profile); (b) the undertaking of an asset allocation study by the consultant/ actuaries; (c) the development of investment guidelines, based on the asset allocation study, that will form part of the agreement with the external asset manager for specific asset classes; and (d) consultations with the Office of Legal Affairs on the contractual engagement of the external asset manager as part of the implementation of the diversified asset allocation strategy. It has already been determined that long- duration liabilities should have long- duration assets, and implementation of a proper diversified strategy for after- service health insurance investments under separate guidelines and benchmarks is well under way.
history.board_assessment: Given that relevant actions have been undertaken to address this issue, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.
